{
  "root_cause": "ArrowRight and ArrowLeft keys increment/decrement the date by exactly one day via adjustDate, ignoring the disableDayFn that marks weekends as non-selectable. Consequently, moving from Friday 20 November lands on Saturday 21 November instead of skipping to Monday 23 November.",
  "repair_strategy": "Add two private methods to Pikaday.prototype: _isDateSelectable(date) to check if a date is enabled (respecting minDate, maxDate, disableWeekends, and disableDayFn), and _moveBy(step) to iterate by day steps until a selectable date is found (with a safety limit). Then replace the ArrowLeft (keyCode 37) and ArrowRight (keyCode 39) cases in _onKeyChange to call _moveBy(-1) and _moveBy(1) respectively, leaving up/down (week) navigation unchanged.",
  "expected_accessibility_effect": "Keyboard users can now navigate to the next or previous selectable day using the arrow keys, skipping weekends and other disabled dates. This restores logical focus order for the date picker and satisfies WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard and 2.4.3 Focus Order.",
  "functional_risks": [
    "If all dates within the min/max range are disabled, _moveBy could loop until the safety limit (1000) is reached and then take no action, leaving the date unchanged.",
    "Performance impact is negligible because the loop only runs over consecutive disabled dates (at most two for weekends).",
    "Users who relied on arrow keys to traverse every calendar day (including disabled ones) will notice a change; however, the clinic's requirement is to skip weekends, which aligns with the intended use case."
  ],
  "verification_requirements": [
    "Verify that with the date picker showing Friday 20 November, pressing ArrowRight results in the input value '2026-11-23'.",
    "Verify that pressing ArrowLeft from Monday 23 November results in '2026-11-20'.",
    "Ensure that month navigation via dropdowns and the next/month buttons still works correctly.",
    "Confirm that shifting weeks with ArrowUp/ArrowDown (adjusting by ±7 days) remains unchanged.",
    "Check that manual date entry and parsing continue to function as before.",
    "Validate that the date picker respects minDate and maxDate limits when arrow keys would otherwise exceed them."
  ]
}
